title: Repeal the restrictions on importing books
action: Amend the Copyright Act to remove the parallel import restrictions on books, with notice for publishers to adjust, as the Productivity Commission and the Harper review recommended.
why: The restrictions let publishers stop booksellers sourcing cheaper legitimate editions from overseas, an implicit tax on readers and schools that mainly benefits overseas rights holders.

evidence.quote: The Australian Government should proceed to repeal parallel import restrictions for books to take effect no later than the end of 2017.

evidence.source: Competition Policy Review: Final Report (Harper review)
evidence.quote: Consistent with the recommendations of recent Productivity Commission reviews, parallel import restrictions on books and second-hand cars should be removed, subject to transitional arrangements as recommended by the Productivity Commission.
